headline.title: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5：接近前沿性能，价格减半
headline.summary: Anthropic 新模型 Claude Opus 5 发布，被描述为“深思熟虑且主动”，接近 Claude Fable 5 的前沿智能，但价格仅为后者一半。早期评价积极，尤其抗提示注入能力显著提升。
headline.summary_en: Anthropic's new model Claude Opus 5 is described as 'thoughtful and proactive', close to the frontier intelligence of Claude Fable 5 at half the price. Early buzz is positive, with notable improvements in prompt injection resistance.
